notes: Vorbis q3, peak -1 dBFS. mixGainDb = suggested gain vs the song master (-14 LUFS). onsetSec = time from file start to the perceptual attack: to land ON a beat, start the file onsetSec early. Loops are exactly periodic. Theme: 70s grindhouse pool hustler. Pitched sounds are at A440, matching the original recording (measured within +-8 cents).
